Key information is Alex proposing Tuesday at 2pm at the west entrance in Willow Park, with Me and Jen agreeing and Jen offering to bring coffee. It is intended for personal record keeping or message export review, requiring no specialized knowledge.

This document is a structured export of iMessage conversations collected on October 5, 2026. It contains two threads, one with Jen about scheduling a phone call and one with Alex about meeting for coffee. Key information includes arranging a Tuesday at 10 am phone call with Jen to go over a job application, which Jen accepts, and Alex proposing to grab coffee tomorrow before a shift at Birch Cafe at 11am after messages about being wiped out on Monday and being starving after getting home.
